item.title: Some Iowa Farmers Switching To Soybeans Due to Nitrogen Cost - KLEM 1410
item.description: A past president of the National Corn Growers Association is predicting some farmers will change their planting intentions from corn to soybeans this year. Kevin Ross of Underwood said that’s because soybeans do not require an application of nitrogen fertilizer. “There’s more likelihood that’s the case just due to balance sheets,” Ross said.
